sources.name: CBN Circular FPR/DIR/CIR/GEN/02/001: Introduction of Three-Tiered Know Your Customer Requirements
CBN Regulatory Framework for Mobile Money Services in Nigeria (July 2021)
Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe: KYC Requirements for Onboarding New Customers by Fintech Companies in Nigeria
CBN Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Regulations (consolidated text, NFIU copy)

entries.subject: tier1_single_deposit_cap
entries.display: KYC Level 1 accounts: maximum single deposit N20,000
entries.quote: It is limited to a maximum single deposit amount of N20,000 and maximum cumulative balance of N200,000 at any point in time.
entries.notes: Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe (2024) restates the same N20,000 cap for low-value accounts.

entries.subject: tier1_balance_cap
entries.display: KYC Level 1 accounts: maximum cumulative balance N200,000
entries.quote: maximum cumulative balance of N200,000 at any point in time
entries.notes: Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe (2024) restates the same N200,000 cap.

entries.subject: tier2_single_deposit_cap
entries.display: KYC Level 2 accounts: maximum single deposit N50,000
entries.quote: The medium-value accounts are limited to a maximum single deposit of N50,000 (Fifty Thousand Naira) and a maximum cumulative balance of N400,000 (Four Hundred Thousand Naira only).
entries.notes: CBN three-tiered KYC circular states the same N50,000 single-deposit cap; the circular's PDF has no text layer so this clean second source is quoted here.

entries.subject: tier2_balance_cap
entries.display: KYC Level 2 accounts: maximum cumulative balance N400,000
entries.quote: and a maximum cumulative balance of N400,000 (Four Hundred Thousand Naira only)
entries.notes: CBN three-tiered KYC circular states the same N400,000 cumulative balance cap.

entries.subject: tier3_balance_cap
entries.display: KYC Level 3 accounts have no limit on cumulative balance, deposit or transactions
entries.quote: there is no limit on cumulative balance, deposit and transactions
entries.notes: Corroborated by the three-tiered KYC circular ('No Limit is placed on cumulative balance') and by Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe (2024) ('High-value account has no financial limits').

entries.subject: mobile_banking_max_transaction
entries.display: Level 1 mobile banking products: maximum transaction N3,000
entries.quote: Maximum transaction limit of N3, 000 and daily limit of N30, 000.

entries.subject: mobile_banking_daily_limit
entries.display: Level 1 mobile banking products: daily limit N30,000
entries.quote: Maximum transaction limit of N3, 000 and daily limit of N30, 000.

entries.subject: mobile_banking_max_transaction
entries.display: Level 2 mobile banking products: maximum transaction N10,000
entries.quote: limit of N10, 000 and (INEC) Voters Register,
entries.notes: Interleaved two-column OCR; cleaned reading is 'Maximum transaction limit of N10, 000'.

entries.subject: mobile_banking_daily_limit
entries.display: Level 2 mobile banking products: daily limit N100,000
entries.quote: BaVINgS: daily limit of N100, Federal Road _ Safety . . . 000.
entries.notes: OCR splits N100, / 000, across two lines with the neighbouring column between them; cleaned reading is a daily limit of N100,000.

entries.subject: wallet_daily_limit
entries.display: Mobile money wallet, KYC level 1: cumulative daily outflow limit N50,000
entries.quote: 1 50,000 300,000, in line with the three-tiered KYC
entries.notes: Table row OCR'd as a single line; cleaned reading in display: level 1, daily cumulative outflow N50,000, balance limit N300,000.

entries.subject: wallet_balance_limit
entries.display: Mobile money wallet, KYC level 1: cumulative balance limit N300,000
entries.quote: 1 50,000 300,000, in line with the three-tiered KYC
entries.notes: Cleaned reading of the interleaved table line: level 1 balance cap N300,000.

entries.subject: account_balance_cap
entries.display: Kuda account opened with name, phone and BVN: maximum balance N300,000
entries.quote: you’ll get an account limited to a maximum balance of 300,000 naira

notes: Tier caps come from the 2013 three-tiered KYC circular; the scanned circular has no text layer so its OCR text is quoted, including OCR spacing inside numbers. Mobile money wallet caps come from the separate 2021 mobile money framework and differ from the bank-account tiers.
